dimensions.basis: Univariate decoded dimensions from the frozen manifest; not in primary score.

fileSize.basis: Univariate file size from the frozen manifest; not in primary score.

format.basis: Format marker from manifest; not in primary score.

metadataPresence.basis: Safe metadata-presence marker only; metadata values are not in primary score.

deviceIdentity.basis: All CSAFE camera rows carry a provenance device label while owner controls intentionally do not; this is curation metadata and not a primary score input.

method: Descriptive univariate AUC after frozen-plan selection; no nuisance variable entered the frozen v0 feature extractor or score.
limitation: The owner control pool is screenshot-heavy and the CSAFE camera dimensions/metadata differ structurally; canonical decoded-pixel results are the relevant nuisance-neutralized diagnostic.
